functionalReqs: Upload videos (up to a few GB)
Stream videos on mobile, web and TV
hints: Why can't you just serve the raw uploaded file to every viewer?
Break transcoding into a DAG of tasks (split, encode per resolution, thumbnails, watermark) run by workers, and stream through a CDN.

Resumable chunked upload to blob storage with pre-signed URLs, a message queue to a transcoding DAG, outputs in HLS/DASH segments at several bitrates, CDN for popular videos with origin fallback for the long tail, and metadata in a sharded DB plus cache.
nonFunctionalReqs: Smooth playback with fast start (under 2 s)
problemStatement:
Design **YouTube**: creators upload videos and viewers stream them smoothly on any device and network.

Focus on the upload and transcoding pipeline and on efficient streaming worldwide.

scaleHints.qps: 500 hours of video uploaded per minute; millions of concurrent streams
scaleHints.storage: Several resolutions per video; exabytes in total

title: Design YouTube (Video Streaming)
